title: Optimal Allocation of Grid-Forming Frequency Shaping Control
summary: Various inverter-based control strategies have been proposed to improve frequency security for power systems with high renewable penetration. Among them, the grid-forming frequency shaping control is particularly promising due to its ability to shape the post-contingency aggregate system frequency dynamics into first-order with prescribed rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) and steady-state frequency deviation.
